jp:
<STBG 3,1><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,90>Sage inviting us to a party,
that's a surprise.

I wonder what kind of party!
Hellooo!
<TALK 5><NAME 10><CHAR 5,5,7,0,0><CV 5,18><MWT 3><BGM 1,0,503>Fiiiiiiire!
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,8><CV 1,90>Huh?

<BGM 0,0,503><CHAR 1,2,1,0,0><CHAR 2,0,10,0,0><TALK 2><NAME 8><CV 11,40>Uncle Andra!
That won't make fire, y'know!

<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,43>Hmm...
even if you say so...

<TALK 2><NAME 8><CHAR 2,0,10,0,0>Wait, whoa!
It's the young lady and the Hunter!
You came!
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,74><CHAR 2,6,10,0,0><CHAR 5,3,10,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0>That just now was...
<TALK 5><NAME 8><CV 11,8>Ah, we were thinking of forming a party!

Andra the uncle as mage,
Amenoma as engineer,
the Hunter as hunter.
<CV 11,33>In theory, a perfect party!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,61>A party, like that...?
What about you, Sage?

<TALK 5><NAME 8>That's obvious!
Sage, of course.
<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,94><CHAR 1,0,1,1,2>...Er, what?

<TALK 5><NAME 8><CV 11,8>There's no role for me
other than Sage, is there!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,61>Ah, yes...
I suppose so...
<CHAR 1,0,1,0,0><CV 1,89>But a party for what, exactly...
<TALK 5><NAME 10><CV 5,35><CHAR 5,0,7,0,0>Hmm, I shall explain.
<CV 5,21>The Zinogre appeared again.

<CV 5,42>And this time, <COL C70101FF>with a different element
than before</COL>... I mean to go hunt it.

<TALK 5><NAME 8><CV 11,34><CHAR 5,0,10,0,0><ITEM AD_BODY519,1,1>And there's a rumour that monster
carries this amazing gear.

<ITEM AD_BODY521,1,1><CV 11,30>Gear that evolves, too —
that's the word on this powerful gear!

<CV 11,25>So that's why we're forming a party
to face it!

<CV 11,20><ITEM WD_BOW163,1,1>And the Nyan Search Corps found
amazing gear on another route, they say!

<ITEM 0,1,0><CV 11,2>So let's party up and
go hunt it together!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,74><CHAR 1,0,1,0,7>No, that party is a bit...
We'll hunt separately!

<TALK 5><NAME 8><CV 11,41>Damn, turned down!
Alright, next is Dr. Sharon.

<CV 11,22>She'd surely suit a dancer role.
Let's go ask!

<CV 1,6><CHAR 1,0,1,0,0>Anyway, it looks like a dangerous
monster, so let's go slay it!
<CLS>
